courses.title: Machine Learning Specialization by Andrew Ng

recommended_projects.title: Predictive Customer Churn Pipeline with Explainability
recommended_projects.description: Build an end-to-end classification system using Scikit-Learn and XGBoost, featuring stratified cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, and SHAP-based feature importance explainability.

recommended_projects.title: Automated Real Estate Valuation Engine
recommended_projects.description: Develop a multi-feature regression model predicting house prices with extensive feature engineering (geocoding, interaction terms) and rigorous residual error analysis.

resources.resume_advice: Quantify your modeling outcomes: state the baseline metric, final metric (e.g. +14% F1-score, -22% RMSE), and the business impact rather than just listing 'used ML'.

recommended_projects.title: Custom PyTorch ResNet Architecture for Medical Imaging
recommended_projects.description: Construct and fine-tune a convolutional neural network with custom data augmentations, learning rate warmup, and Grad-CAM visual explainability.

resources.resume_advice: Explicitly highlight neural network architectures, custom loss functions, training epochs, and GPU optimization techniques you implemented.

recommended_projects.title: Semantic Document Search Engine using S-BERT and FAISS
recommended_projects.description: Build a dense vector retrieval pipeline utilizing sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 and FAISS indexing for sub-10ms semantic document similarity search.

recommended_projects.title: Aspect-Based Sentiment Analyzer with Transformers
recommended_projects.description: Fine-tune a DistilBERT or RoBERTa classifier to identify product feature mentions and categorize associated customer sentiments.

certifications: Stanford Online Natural Language Processing with Deep Learning
resources.resume_advice: Distinguish between legacy rule-based/token-counting techniques and modern dense vector / transformer embedding methodologies.

courses.title: Generative AI with Large Language Models

recommended_projects.title: Enterprise RAG System with Vector Hybrid Search & Guardrails
recommended_projects.description: Architect a production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation agent with chunking optimizations, reranking, source citation attribution, and hallucination evaluation.

resources.resume_advice: Demonstrate understanding of context windows, prompt evaluation benchmarks, vector retrieval latency, and fine-tuning techniques (LoRA/QLoRA).

recommended_projects.title: Containerized FastAPI ML Microservice on AWS with CI/CD
recommended_projects.description: Containerize a trained XGBoost / PyTorch model with Docker, deploy to AWS EC2 or ECS, configure GitHub Actions automated testing, and log endpoint latency.

recommended_projects.title: MLflow Experiment Tracking and Model Registry Pipeline
recommended_projects.description: Integrate MLflow tracking into model training scripts, log metrics/artifacts, and configure automated model promotion to staging and production.

resources.resume_advice: Emphasize production readiness: Docker containerization, REST API throughput (RPS), p99 latency guarantees, and drift monitoring.

courses.title: Test-Driven Development with FastAPI and Docker

recommended_projects.title: Asynchronous High-Throughput Microservice with JWT & Pydantic
recommended_projects.description: Build an async RESTful service using FastAPI, Pydantic v2 validation models, JWT bearer token authentication, rate limiting, and automated Swagger documentation.

resources.resume_advice: Highlight async endpoint architecture, OpenAPI documentation generation, schema validation, and unit test coverage with pytest and HTTPX.

recommended_projects.title: Scalable Cloud Architecture with S3, EC2, and CloudWatch
recommended_projects.description: Deploy a multi-tier web application using AWS S3 for secure object storage, EC2 compute with security groups, and CloudWatch monitoring alerts.

resources.resume_advice: Mention specific cloud services (S3, EC2, IAM, CloudWatch) and the security practices followed (least privilege IAM roles, secure presigned URLs).

recommended_projects.title: E-Commerce Relational Database Design and Query Optimization
recommended_projects.description: Design a 3NF normalized PostgreSQL schema with indexes, multi-table analytical window functions, CTEs, and query execution plan (EXPLAIN ANALYZE) optimization.

resources.resume_advice: Highlight complex analytical queries (window functions, CTEs) and query execution optimization rather than basic SELECT statements.

recommended_projects.title: Modern Interactive SaaS Dashboard with Vite, Tailwind, & Recharts
recommended_projects.description: Construct a responsive single-page web app with client-side routing, strongly-typed API contracts, interactive data charts, and accessible modal dialogs.

resources.resume_advice: Highlight strict TypeScript configuration, reusable component architecture, state management patterns, and responsive web accessibility.

recommended_projects.title: Multi-Stage Containerized Full-Stack Stack with Docker Compose
recommended_projects.description: Create optimized multi-stage Docker builds for both a React frontend and a FastAPI backend with persistent volume mounts and container networking.

resources.resume_advice: Showcase multi-stage builds that reduce image size (e.g. from 1.2GB to 140MB) and reproducible development environments.

general_advice: Use the Google XYZ formula: 'Accomplished [X] as measured by [Y], by doing [Z]'.
Focus on capabilities and technical depth rather than stuffing raw keywords.
Include direct links to live GitHub repositories, interactive demos, or published documentation for every project.
Explicitly state the data size, throughput, latency, or accuracy metrics achieved in your engineering projects.
